title: Satisfy formatting and nf-core lint requirements
description: Format the affected documentation, add versions.yml coverage to the new pipeline tests, and restore the generated container configuration files required by nf-core lint.
acceptance_criteria: Prettier makes no changes; Sylph and uBAM tests snapshot versions.yml; required container configuration files are committed; focused lint passes or remaining warnings are documented.
close_reason: Pre-commit passes; nf-core container-config lint has zero failures; required test snapshots are covered

title: Align nf-test CI version and profile handling
description: Update GitHub Actions to use the locally validated nf-test release and verify test_sylph and test_ubam profiles are preserved alongside each container profile.
acceptance_criteria: CI uses nf-test 0.9.5 or a verified compatible release; remote invocation retains the selected test profile; local CI-mode tests pass for Docker.
close_reason: nf-test 0.9.5 and per-test configs pass the exact CI docker profile

title: Establish dev branch and retarget PR #1
description: Publish the existing local dev branch from main to origin, retarget PR #1 to dev, and confirm the branch-protection and pipeline-download workflows resolve the requested revision.
acceptance_criteria: origin/dev exists; PR #1 targets dev; branch policy and download revision no longer reject the PR because dev is absent.
close_reason: Published origin/dev at the verified template baseline and retargeted PR #1 to dev

title: Repair PR #1 CI and nf-core branch topology
description: Make the ONT contaminant-screening PR conform to the repository branch policy and pass its focused nf-test, formatting, and nf-core lint checks.
acceptance_criteria: Remote dev branch and PR target are resolved; CI uses the tested nf-test release; test snapshots and required lint assets are present; local verification results are recorded.

title: Verify CI repairs and update PR #1
description: Run focused local nf-test and lint checks, inspect the PR results after publication, and record any residual hosted-only issues without broadening the workflow scope.
acceptance_criteria: Focused local tests and lint are recorded; fixes are pushed; PR #1 check state is inspected and residual failures have evidence.
close_reason: CI-mode uBAM and Sylph tests, full nf-core lint, pre-commit, and diff check pass locally
